beliefs: Between x=-16 and x=-8 the curve steepens smoothly (slope goes from ~-0.532 at -16 to ~-1.55 at -8), not a straight line [E24]
For x in [-8,-2] the curve is smooth, fitted by knots at -8,-4,-3,-2.5,-2 [E19, E23]
Between x=-2 and x=0 the slope steepens smoothly; f(0)=-8.8302 with local slope ~-3.5 [E1, E6, E22]
For 0<x<5 the segment is essentially straight with slope ~-3.317, reaching f(5)=-25.4152 [E7, E9, E16]
For 5<=x<=5.5 the branch is a straight line with slope ~-3.0468 [E20]
For 5.5<=x<=8 the branch is a straight line with slope ~-3.046: f(5.5)=-26.9386, f(8)=-34.5556 [E12, E13]
For 9<=x<=12 the branch is a straight line with slope ~-0.846: f(9)=-35.5529, f(12)=-38.0921 [E12, E13]
For x>12 the branch flattens progressively; piecewise-linear knots from E8/E21 are used [E8, E21]
